snippet.title: Stickup Willie - Official Alpha Teaser Trailer | 2.5D Western Platformer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5069700/Stickup_Willie/
Play the free Alpha Demo during Steam Next Fest this October!

Step into the boots of a frontier outlaw in Stickup Willie, a fast-paced 2.5D platformer game demo. Navigate dangerous terrain, outsmart exaggerated foes, and survive the wild frontier. Traverse classic western environments, from dodging TNT barrels to exploring town buildings.

Developed by Take10 Games, the game features a unique visual aesthetic. Inspired by 1930's cartoons, the world is brought to life with sketchy ink lines, exaggerated proportions, a limited color palette, and textured paper.

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and let us know what you think in the comments!
